subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a Gateway/provider-backed editable dictation workflow in the Control UI composer now, or should the work be folded into the broader WebChat STT/TTS product direction?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new user-facing Control UI microphone workflow and a browser-to-Gateway transcription method that changes provider, credential, and microphone-audio boundaries; automation cannot choose that product/security tradeoff.

options.title: Sponsor the linked Gateway-backed PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 after proof and security/provider-boundary concerns are resolved.

options.title: Fold into broader voice direction
options.body: Keep this issue as context but centralize implementation decisions in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 before accepting a narrow dictation PR.

options.title: Defer core dictation
options.body: Close or pause the core feature if maintainers do not want another Control UI microphone path beyond Talk and attachments right now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked Gateway-backed PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 after proof and security/provider-boundary concerns are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior merged server-side dictation implementation and is the strongest feature-history routing signal for this product boundary.
